name: Sliplane Managed Postgres

evidence.sql: C02: hosted managed PostgreSQL is the primary type; D01: native PostgreSQL SQL
evidence.vector: V02: pgvector enabled from the supported extension catalog; V01: pgvector supported

line: Managed PostgreSQL with TLS, PITR backups, and optional pgvector.

free.text: No free tier; pausing keeps billing; nonpayment can lead to deletion

sql.math: The published one-month price includes 1 vCPU, 1 GB of RAM, 10 GB of disk and 100 connections. Query performance is untested.
The kept monthly Starter plan stays at €19 while idle or paused. Pausing does not stop billing.

files.math: Sliplane Object Storage is separate from managed PostgreSQL

jobs.math: Managed Postgres does not host worker jobs.
